45554-doctor-birch-and-his-young-friends.title: Doctor Birch And His Young Friends
45554-doctor-birch-and-his-young-friends.creator: Mr. M. A. Titmarsh.
45554-doctor-birch-and-his-young-friends.description: A book by Mr. M. A. Titmarsh.. The real master of the school is Prince; an Oxford man too: shy, haughty, and learned; crammed with Greek and a quantity of useless learning; uncommonly kind to the small boys; pitiless with the fools and the braggarts: respected of all for his honesty, his learning, his bravery, (for he hit out once in a boat-row in a way which astonished the boys and the bargemen,) and for a latent power about him, which all saw and confessed somehow.

arxiv-1512-04250.title: A Highly Literate Approach to Ontology Building
arxiv-1512-04250.creator: Phillip Lord and Jennifer D. Warrender
arxiv-1512-04250.description: Abstract Ontologies present an attractive technology for describing bio-medicine, because they can be shared, and have rich computational properties. However, they lack the rich expressivity of English and fit poorly with the current scientific “publish or perish” model. While, there have been attempts to combine free text and ontologies, most of these perform post-hoc annotation of text.

arxiv-2103-05737.title: The AI Arena: A Framework for Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2103-05737.creator: Edward W. Staley, Corban G.Rivera, Ashley J. Llorens
arxiv-2103-05737.description: Abstract Advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have resulted in recent breakthroughs in the application of artificial intelligence (AI) across many different domains. An emerging landscape of development environments is making powerful RL techniques more accessible for a growing community of researchers.

arxiv-2109-15297.title: Signatures of quartic asymmetric exchange in a class of two dimensional magnets
arxiv-2109-15297.creator: G. Rakhmanova, A. Osipov, D. Ilyin, I. Shushakova, I. A. Ado, I. Iorsh, M. Titov
arxiv-2109-15297.description: Abstract Indirect quartic interaction of spins is suggested to play an important role in two dimensional magnets with trigonal prismatic symmetry such as Fe 3 GeTe 2 monolayer. The proposed interaction is described by terms in micromagnetic energy that are linear in magnetization gradients. Such terms enable the stability of non-collinear magnetic textures.

arxiv-2112-08251.title: Relativistic Magnetized Astrophysical Plasma Outflows in Black-Hole Microquasars
arxiv-2112-08251.creator: Theodora Papavasileiou 1, Odysseas Kosmas 2, Ioannis Sinatkas 1
arxiv-2112-08251.description: Abstract Recently, microquasar jets have aroused the interest of many researchers focusing on the astrophysical plasma outflows and various jet ejections. In this work, we concentrate on the investigation of electromagnetic radiation and particle emissions from the jets of stellar black hole binary systems characterized by the hadronic content in their jets.

arxiv-2402-15637.title: Addressing Order Sensitivity of In-Context Demonstration Examples in Causal Language Models
arxiv-2402-15637.creator: Yanzheng Xiang , Hanqi Yan, Lin Gui, Yulan He
arxiv-2402-15637.description: Abstract In-context learning has become a popular paradigm in natural language processing. However, its performance can be significantly influenced by the order of in-context demonstration examples. In this paper, we found that causal language models (CausalLMs) are more sensitive to this order compared to prefix language models (PrefixLMs).

arxiv-2409-00481.title: DCIM-AVSR:Efficient Audio-Visual Speech Recognition via Dual Conformer Interaction Module
arxiv-2409-00481.creator: Xinyu Wang 1 , Haotian Jiang 1 , Haolin Huang 1 , Yu Fang 1 , Mengjie Xu 1 , Qian Wang 1 ∗
arxiv-2409-00481.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Wang 1 , Haotian Jiang 1 , Haolin Huang 1 , Yu Fang 1 , Mengjie Xu 1 , Qian Wang 1 ∗. Speech recognition is the technology that enables machines to interpret and process human speech, converting spoken language into text or commands. This technology is essential for applications such as virtual assistants, transcription services, and communication tools. The Audio-Visual Speech Recognition (AVSR) model enhances traditional speech recognition, particularly in noisy environments, by incorporating visual modalities like lip movements and facial expressions.

arxiv-2505-21333.title: MME-VideoOCR: Evaluating OCR-Based Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Video Scenarios
arxiv-2505-21333.creator: Yang Shi Huanqian Wang Wulin Xie Huanyao Zhang Lijie Zhao Yi-Fan Zhang, Xinfeng Li Chaoyou Fu Zhuoer Wen Wenting Liu Zhuoran Zhang Xinlong Chen, Bohan Zeng Sihan Yang Yushuo Guan Zhang Zhang Liang Wang Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin Yuanxing Zhang Pengfei Wan Haotian Wang Wenjing Yang, ⋄ Core Contributor
arxiv-2505-21333.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved considerable accuracy in Optical Character Recognition (OCR) from static images. However, their efficacy in video OCR is significantly diminished due to factors such as motion blur, temporal variations, and visual effects inherent in video content.

arxiv-2512-20767.title: Critical exponents of boomerang subgroups in the free group
arxiv-2512-20767.creator: Waltraud Lederle
arxiv-2512-20767.description: Abstract We construct, for the free group acting on its Cayley tree, boomerang subgroups whose critical exponent is arbitrarily close to the critical exponent of a given finitely generated subgroup. 1 Introduction Let (X,d_{X}) be a proper geodesic Gromov hyperbolic metric space and \mathrm{Iso}(X) its group of isometries.

pmc-10570439.title: Local and long-range GABAergic circuits in hippocampal area CA1 and their link to Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-10570439.creator: Melissa Hernández-Frausto, Olesia M. Bilash, Arjun V. Masurkar, Jayeeta Basu
pmc-10570439.description: GABAergic inhibitory neurons are the principal source of inhibition in the brain. Traditionally, their role in maintaining the balance of excitation-inhibition has been emphasized. Beyond homeostatic functions, recent circuit mapping and functional manipulation studies have revealed a wide range of specific roles that GABAergic circuits play in dynamically tilting excitation-inhibition coupling across spatio-temporal scales.

pmc-11286078.title: Fatal SARS-CoV-2 Infection among Children, Japan, January–September 20221
pmc-11286078.creator: Shingo Mitsushima, Yuichiro Yahata, Yuuki Tsuchihashi, Chiaki Ikenoue, Munehisa Fukusumi, Shogo Otake, Tomoe Shimada, Takuya Yamagishi, Hajime Kamiya, Yusuke Kobayashi, Hitomi Kurosu, Mai Okuyama, Saeko Morino, Miho Shibamura, Sayaka Takanashi, Taro Kamigaki, Kanako Otani, Manami Nakashita, Hanae It
pmc-11286078.description: To determine the characteristics of pediatric patients 0–19 years of age who died after onset of SARS-CoV-2 infection in Japan during January 1–September 30, 2022, we reviewed multiple sources. We identified 62 cases, collected detailed information from medical records and death certificates, and conducted interviews, resulting in 53 patients with detailed information for our study.

pmc-12576408.title: Therapeutic Plasma Exchange in Severe Graves Disease With Hematologic and Hepatic Complications
pmc-12576408.creator: Vivek Jha, Amal Shaharyar, Kavyanjali Kundu, Siddharth Madhad, Sanja Medenica, Pinaki Dutta
pmc-12576408.description: We report 2 young women with severe Graves thyrotoxicosis in whom antithyroid drugs were contraindicated—one due to drug induced moderate neutropenia and the other due to Graves disease–associated hepatic dysfunction and cytopenia. Both patients presented with life-threatening manifestations of thyrotoxicosis and were unsuitable for immediate surgery or radioiodine therapy.
